parent_wording: generalization / stability: aggregated across development discharges and all three predeclared temporal blocks

parent_machine_readable_definition.content: criterion NAME only; no stronger machine-readable operational definition exists
parent_machine_readable_definition.conflict_check_note: the section-11 operationalization was compared against the only machine-readable parent (K_REC_PRE_V2 U_rec) and against UTILITY_AND_QUALIFICATION_POLICY.md; the parent constrains the criterion name, its rank and its data scope, all of which are honoured; no override occurred

block_worst.definition: max over b in {A,B,C} of (mean_s NRMSE_{s,b}(C))
block_worst.aggregation_order: discharges first, then the maximum over blocks

worst_block.tie_break: earliest block in the canonical order A < B < C

equivalence.paired_difference: d_s(A,B) = NRMSE_{s, b_star(A)}(A) - NRMSE_{s, b_star(B)}(B); each candidate contributes its OWN worst block
equivalence.coherence_proof: mean_s d_s(A,B) = BLOCK_WORST(A) - BLOCK_WORST(B) exactly, so the paired discharge-level differences average to precisely the candidate-level quantity being compared; the SE is therefore the standard error OF THAT difference and introduces no discretion

fallback_rule.content: use the fixed absolute 0.01 NRMSE floor only, and record the qualification
fallback_rule.reason: a mathematically coherent paired-SE definition WAS implementable without discretion, because b_star(C) is determined by the frozen formula and its A<B<C tie-break; the fallback is therefore not invoked

shot_p90.estimator_frozen_because: percentile estimators differ between conventions; the library default is fixed here so the quantity is reproducible, not chosen to favour any outcome
shot_p90.interpolation_note: for n=20 the linear method interpolates between the 18th and 19th order statistics at index 0.9*19 = 17.1
shot_p90.minimized: deterministically, after the BLOCK_WORST equivalence restriction

rank_2_order: among candidates practically equivalent on BLOCK_WORST, minimize SHOT_P90 exactly
exact_minimum_semantics: the SHOT_P90 step takes the exact argmin; ties are retained in full and resolved by later ranks, never by a new tolerance
domain_reading: every quantity defined here is evaluated over the frozen explored frontier Ahat_rec only; A_rec minus Ahat_rec remains ADMISSIBLE_UNSEARCHED and carries no negative finding
